description: This file contains implementation of the ResolvedTargetData class methods, which manage target information, dependencies, and build configurations within a build system, likely related to Chromium's build infrastructure.

classes.name: TargetInfo
classes.description: Structure holding detailed information about a build target, including dependencies, libraries, frameworks, and language-specific data.

methods.name: GetTargetInfo
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a TargetInfo object for a given target, managing thread-safe access to internal data structures.

methods.name: ComputeLibInfo
methods.description: Calculates and populates library directories and library files for a target, including dependencies.

methods.name: ComputeFrameworkInfo
methods.description: Calculates and populates framework directories, frameworks, and weak frameworks for a target, including dependencies.

methods.name: ComputeHardDeps
methods.description: Determines and sets the set of hard dependencies for a target, considering binary and Swift modules.

methods.name: ComputeInheritedLibs
methods.description: Computes and sets inherited libraries for a target based on its dependencies.

methods.name: ComputeInheritedLibsFor
methods.description: Helper function to recursively compute inherited libraries from dependencies, considering dependency types and visibility.

methods.name: ComputeModuleDepsInformation
methods.description: Calculates module dependency information for a target.

methods.name: ComputeModuleDepsInformationFor
methods.description: Helper function to process dependencies and gather module dependency info.

methods.name: ComputeRustLibs
methods.description: Calculates and sets Rust libraries for a target, including inherited and inheritable libs.

methods.name: ComputeRustLibsFor
methods.description: Helper function to process dependencies and gather Rust library info.

methods.name: ComputeSwiftValues
methods.description: Calculates and sets Swift module information for a target, including public and private modules.
